content_sections.heading: JIPMER Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies or the application fee.

rows.details: Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER), Puducherry
An implementation research study on developing a high-quality patient-centric integrated model for emergency care systems in selected districts of India
Likely 6 months (extended up to one year based on satisfactory performance of the candidate)
Project Technical Support – I (Data Entry Operator)
Up to 28 years (as on last date of receipt of applications)
JIPMER, Puducherry/Karaikal; interview location: Department of Emergency Medicine and Trauma, JIPMER Puducherry

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: 10th + Diploma in computer Application/IT/Computer sciences with two years' experience in EDP work in Government Autonomous, PSU or any other recognized organization. A speed of not less than 8000 key depressions per hour on computer. Good command of Tamil and English typing, speaking, reading and writing. The qualification and experience should be in a relevant discipline/field and from a reputable institution/organization. The experience should have been gained after acquiring the essential qualification. Experience in MS-office/ data entry/ statistical software. Experience in transcribing qualitative data and data entry of patient level database. The maximum age limit is up to 28 years, counted as on the last date of receipt of applications. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Qualification, experience, other terms and conditions may be relaxed or altered at the discretion of the Principal Investigator. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 21,600/- per month, made up of Rs. 18,000/- plus Rs. 3,600 as 20% HRA. The notice states that the consolidated salary may vary from time to time and that no other allowance or facilities other than the consolidated salary will be extended.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Data entry of quantitative and qualitative data, including transcripts (Tamil/English) generated during interviews and focused group discussions.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JIPMER Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: A valid email ID and mobile number are compulsory. Candidates may attach their CVs with the application form, but applications with a CV alone, without the prescribed form and certificates, will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection runs in this order: shortlisting, a written test and an interview. Shortlisting: applicants will be shortlisted based on the details in the application, CV and documentary proof. If the number of applications is very large, more stringent criteria than those specified may be used to determine eligibility. The list of eligible candidates will also be displayed on the JIPMER website. Written test and interview: only shortlisted candidates will be called for the written test and interview. The final selection will be based on the CV, application, and written test/interview, and the decision of the Project Investigator will be final. Interview mode: interviews will be conducted in person, at the discretion of the Principal Investigator, at the Department of Emergency Medicine and Trauma, JIPMER Puducherry. The date and time of the interview will be notified one week in advance.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JIPMER Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: Complete applications must be sent by email up to 4:30 PM on 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is required for JIPMER Project Technical Support – I?
faq.answer: Candidates need 10th + Diploma in computer Application/IT/Computer sciences with two years' experience in EDP work in a Government Autonomous, PSU or other recognized organization, a speed of not less than 8000 key depressions per hour, and good command of Tamil and English.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this JIPMER project post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is up to 28 years as on the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the JIPMER Data Entry Operator?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 21,600/- pm, which is Rs. 18,000/- plus Rs. 3,600 as 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA or any other allowance paid on top of Rs. 21,600?
faq.answer: No. The 20% HRA is already included in the Rs. 21,600/- consolidated amount, and no other allowance or facilities other than the consolidated salary will be extended.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for JIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email the filled prescribed application form, CV and supporting documents, scanned in one PDF named "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application", to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. What should I write in the email subject line?
faq.answer: Mention the name of the post applied for, Project Technical Support – I (Data Entry Operator), in the email subject line.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Applicants are shortlisted on their application, CV and documents, and shortlisted candidates are called for a written test and an in-person interview, whose date and time will be notified one week in advance.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job at JIPMER?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely on contract for an externally sponsored project, likely for 6 months (extended up to one year based on satisfactory performance), with no claim to any regular post in JIPMER.

faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
